description: Ship a UI surface where an operator can drop a fixture directory (Go source + expected-graph.json) and see the diff between expected and actual extraction. Directly accelerates the determinism tests that consumers like cartographer depend on.

requirements.description: Ship a UI surface where an operator can provide a fixture directory path (containing Go source files and an expected-graph.json) and trigger an extraction comparison. The UI must display a structured diff between the expected-graph.json and the actual extracted graph, highlighting added nodes/edges, removed nodes/edges, and changed fields. This surface directly accelerates fixture authoring and debugging for the golden determinism gate.
requirements.title: Fixture Validator UI for Determinism Diff Inspection

validation.notes: Test diff computation function: given expected and actual graphs, produces structured diff with added/removed/changed entries
Test diff renderer component: added nodes shown in green, removed nodes in red, changed fields highlighted
Test that an identical expected and actual graph produces an empty diff and a passing indicator
End-to-end UI test: operator provides go-cycles fixture path, UI extracts graph and shows zero-diff against expected-graph.json
End-to-end UI test: operator provides a fixture with a modified expected-graph.json; UI shows the specific node/edge differences
Fixture validator UI invokes only the Extract Connect-RPC endpoint; no direct filesystem reads from the browser
Fixture authors can validate expected-graph.json correctness without running CLI or reading raw JSON
Cartographer team can use the validator UI to confirm extraction behavior before updating expected fixtures

title: Fixture Validator UI
